text:
maria gonzalez: Heads-up — trying to wire the new starterkit into the monorepo sample (Next.js + LangChain + LlamaIndex) and hitting an auth/retry loop on Edge.
alex chen: Same. Repro steps: deploy next-edge sample, call /api/generate which uses redwood-sdk fetch wrapper, intermittent 401 then infinite retry. Looks like Authorization header dropped on retry.
jamal: I saw that with the node SDK too. The retry wrapper reconstructs the Request but forgets to forward `req.headers.get('authorization')` when retrying.
yoni: Filed issue #3421 and pushed a minimal failing test: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/3421 — it's specifically the fetch-like client in @redwood/sdk-edge.
devex-bot: Issue #3421 created by yoni — labels: bug, sdk, edge
tina: For the starterkit we should avoid relying on implicit header forwarding. Can we add an explicit `authorization` header in the sample's helper and a note in README? New users get stuck here.
alex chen: Quick patch suggestion — in the retry handler do:
```
const headers = new Headers(origReq.headers);
if (!headers.has('authorization') && ctx.token) headers.set('authorization', `Bearer ${ctx.token}`);
const retryReq = new Request(origReq, { headers });
```
That keeps parity between first attempt and retries.
maria gonzalez: Nice. We also need an eval harness test to catch regressions: run the sample with a synthetic token expiry and assert single successful retry rather than infinite loop.
jamal: I can add a smoke test to samples/e2e that runs under `yarn test:samples` — will instrument fetch with a flaky auth endpoint.
yoni: Also propose editing starter README to call out Edge pitfalls and show the explicit header pattern. New onboarding tickets keep surfacing this.
tina: Should we hotfix the published starter template? customers on Dedicated reported this as onboarding friction.
alex chen: We should — will open a PR to main starter (monorepo/starter-next) and bump sdk-edge to include the retry fix. Tagging @maria to review the README changes.
maria gonzalez: I'll review. Also adding an eval/quality check: `eval-harness run --sample monorepo-starter --simulate-auth-failures` to CI.
yoni: PR #3422 in review: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/3422 — includes unit test + starter README update.
jamal: Putting a short workaround snippet in the sample code until sdk-edge patch lands. Quick test passes locally :thumbsup:
maria gonzalez: Thanks team. Follow-up: add a one-liner in the onboarding checklist so Solutions Eng can triage quickly if a user hits 401s on Edge templates. :white_check_mark:
